tools.name: auth_requestAccess
tools.description: Request a PAT token for API access. No authentication required — this is the bootstrap entry point. Sends an approval email to the workspace admin. Returns a request_id and poll_token for polling approval status.

owner_email.description: Email of the workspace admin who will approve the request

project_name.description: Name of the project requesting access

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_requestAccessByEmail
tools.description: Simplified PAT request — email only, auto-discovers all brands the admin belongs to. No authentication required.

owner_email.description: Email of the admin who will approve

project_name.description: Name of the project requesting access

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_checkAccessStatus
tools.description: Poll for PAT request approval status. When approved, auto-stores the token in OPVS_PAT so all subsequent tool calls are authenticated. Returns status: pending, approved, denied, or expired.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_getMe
tools.description: Get the current user's profile including all brand memberships. Returns user details (name, email, photo, role) and a list of brands the user belongs to with their role and position.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_completeSignup
tools.description: Complete signup by creating a user profile, brand, and membership. Called after Better Auth signup succeeds. Creates the user record, a new brand, brand_settings, brand_information, and brand_membership.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_signupWithInvite
tools.description: Complete signup using an invitation token. Creates the user profile and adds them to the inviting brand as a client member.

invite_token.description: The invitation token from the invite link

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_acceptInvite
tools.description: Accept a brand invitation as an already-authenticated user. Adds the user to the inviting brand without re-authentication.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_updateProfile
tools.description: Update the current user's profile. Supports partial updates for first name, last name, and mobile number. Automatically recomputes full_name from first + last.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_uploadProfilePhoto
tools.description: Upload a profile picture. Resizes to 256x256 JPEG and stores in Cloudflare R2. Accepts PNG, JPG, or GIF up to 5MB.

file.description: Image file path or base64 data (PNG, JPG, or GIF, max 5MB)

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_removeProfilePhoto
tools.description: Remove the current user's profile picture. Cleans up the R2 file if stored there.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: auth_getConnectors
tools.description: List connected OAuth providers for the current user. Returns provider name, connection date, and associated email for each linked social login (GitHub, Google, etc.). Excludes credential (email/password) entries.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)
